Real loopback HTTP server stalls before headers and after the first received body chunk. Cancellation interrupts both stages within one second while the server remains connected. The worker owner separately verifies instance-lock retention across started blocking update work.

Includes all ten frozen structured error/exit mappings, updater stalled headers/body, source-descriptor lifetime, official transport cancellation, controller recovery/startup lease and shutdown ownership. Final lifetime-guard chaining and lint-only read-count/duplicate-branch cleanup were subsequently compiled by the shared strict all-target Clippy run.

Source-replayed YAML whole-number notation becomes integer JSON before validation and consumption; fractional CPUs remain fractional, integer fields reject fractions, and size numbers respect JavaScript safe-integer bounds. The new test failed before the fix. Expected output was replayed through frozen v1 yaml parser and ProjectConfigSchema at the recorded baseline.
